profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cambia Health Solutions
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the AdTech and financial/mortgage services industry. Experience in Databases design, frontend & backend development, Clojure, C#, and AWS Services, Angular, Python, Typescript. Self motivated engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science - BS focused in Computer Science from California State University, Northridge. 

I am always looking to push myself further and enjoy testing the waters with new development stacks and technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead/host our Engineering Departments Golang Community Of Practice
  * Develop learning criteria to capture and share knowledge
* Migration of Clojure projects to Golang
* Contributing code across application, and platform code repositories
* Perform and/or direct testing and documents the results
  * Primarily testing load on services and tuning services or libraries based on results
* Develop efficient and effective program and system solutions in solving business problems
* Improving documentation, code quality, ensuring code coverage standards are met

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer supporting apps based of; front-end, typescript with Angular, back-end, java with Spring. 

Tasks ranged from building up new apps and features to automating tasks 

Redesigning our CI/CD pipelines for our projects to release our products quicker and reduce the risk of handler mistakes, as we did not have any automated process. 

Set up with the task of setting up some code analysis and security software on our code base (Sonarqube/Veracode). Since analysis I’ve been improving our test coverage and addressing security vulnerabilities in our apps. 

Contributing greatly to the team and our mission of identifying areas that our code base or system can improve and rolling out features as they come in. 

Mentoring Jr Devs and hosting code reviews.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Part of a functional team which implements Agile/Scrum methodologies. I help maintain our core Web Applications, implementing business logic as demand see’s fit; where our backend is done in Clojure and frontend, ClojureScript. 

At the time I had been the lead developer in our Serverless applications. Designing architecture (AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, API GateWay, SQS, CloudWatch), setting up infrastructure (AWS Cloud Formation, Troposphere), and developing business logic with python in a TDD environment using pytest.

positions.title: Application Developer Contractor
positions.description:
Hired on as a contractor to help buildup, maintain, and fix previous bugs to applications that I had previously worked on. Having finished the MongoDB to PostgreSQL migration, I created database queries that would dig in to document style data, which I then used to fill target tables in our database.  

Created a DMS job that was done to create nightly copy jobs from table-to-table & database-to-database that would feed relevant data that is used for other teams. 

Adding features that help our internal users diagnose issues that come up as they make various API requests. Addition new features to our UI which relate to readability of data and interactions between client/user.  

Created/analyzed/ conducted various load-tests and UI-tests against our servers using Jmeter to ensure new apps would scale appropriately.

positions.title: Applications Development Intern
positions.description: I was brought on to assist one of the Application Development teams. My primary role was to assist in migrating Movr’s (our main application) transaction database from MongoDB to PostgreSQL. This required writing & testing new database access calls in Clojure. I developed unit tests using Midje (Clojure library) to test the new work I introduced. At the time I also worked on migrating our Movr2 Admin Server to Movr3 which includes refactoring code, fixing bugs, and adding new enhancements. Along the way I attained a good understanding of the Clojure language and what functional programing has to offer and a good grasp of relational/non-relational databases.
